reference.notes: The machine-translated transcript is garbled. Arirang is the only named food place; the brunch, first bar and milk tea spots are unnamed, so they are subject none. The climb with tickets and a view (a landmark) and 'brand advocate' (Brandenburger Tor) are not places and say nothing about food, so they are left out. 'Most delicious and tasteless' likely means 'most delicious and authentic'; 'quality quite substantial' is read as a further decline.

match.note: Berlin has several Korean restaurants named Arirang (Arirang Restaurant, Arirang Bulgogi, Matzip Arirang), and the post gives no location to tell which one is meant.
